blocks.text: Delete operation database se ghair zaroori data mitata hai aur database ko saaf aur durust rakhta hai. SQL DELETE commands shart (condition) ke saath istemal hoti hain, is liye Python sirf chune hue records mitata hai. Ehtiyat se istemal karne se zaroori data zaya nahi hota.

import sqlite3
# Connect to the database
connection = sqlite3.connect("school.db")
# Create a cursor object
cursor = connection.cursor()
# Execute DELETE query (example: delete student with ID = 1)
cursor.execute("DELETE FROM students WHERE ID = 1")
# Save changes
connection.commit()
# Display confirmation
print("Record deleted successfully")
# Close the connection
connection.close()

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"connection = sqlite3.connect("school.db")" aur "cursor = connection.cursor()": pehle wali database file se jorta hai aur cursor banata hai.
"cursor.execute("DELETE FROM students WHERE ID = 1")": students table se sirf woh row mitata hai jis ka ID 1 ho; WHERE shart (condition) hai. SQL mein column ke naam ke chhote bare huroof (ID ya id) se farq nahi parta.
"connection.commit()": mitana pakka (permanent) karta hai.
"print("Record deleted successfully")": tasdeeq (confirmation) ka paigham. "connection.close()": connection band.
Output: "Record deleted successfully". Yeh paigham har dafa aata hai, chahe ID 1 wali row mili ho ya na mili ho (DELETE ko kuch na mile to bhi ghalti nahi hoti). Lekin agar school.db mein students table hi na ho (pehle wala connection program na chala ho), to program "sqlite3.OperationalError: no such table: students" de kar ruk jata hai. Is liye pehle oopar wala program chalayein.

items: DELETE FROM students WHERE ID = 1 → aik khaas record mitata hai.
connection.commit() → tabdeeli database mein mehfooz karta hai.
commit() ke baghair delete pakka (permanent) nahi hota.

blocks.title: UPDATE aur DELETE ke saath hamesha WHERE shart
blocks.text: WHERE ke baghair DELETE FROM students; har row mita deta hai, aur WHERE ke baghair UPDATE har row badal deta hai. Command chalane se pehle shart jaanch lein.

items: Delete = DELETE FROM ... WHERE: sirf chuna hua record mitta hai.
commit() ke baghair mitana pakka nahi hota.
